slot_scores.name: protein_purchase_quantity_type
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are the protein options (chicken, salmon, tofu) also sold in 100g units where only whole 100g units can be purchased, or can they be purchased in any continuous amount?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked whether proteins are continuous or discrete/whole-unit, matching the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: min_vegetable_types_required
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Does the requirement to select at least three different types of vegetables mean that you must purchase at least one whole pack of each of three distinct vegetable types, or is it sufficient to purchase at least one pack total from three different vegetable categories?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent engaged with the three-distinct-vegetable requirement only after the user volunteered it, and then clarified its pack interpretation rather than independently asking whether a minimum number of vegetable types was required.

stopping_behavior.rationale: At READY_TO_MODEL, H1 was resolved, but H2 was not proactively asked and only appeared because the user volunteered it, leaving a P1 hidden slot unresolved.

summary: The agent directly resolved H1 and clarified several boundary constraints, but H2 was only partially engaged with after the user volunteered the minimum vegetable-type requirement; a P1 hidden slot therefore remained unresolved at READY_TO_MODEL.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
